06-exit.jpg.name: 06-exit.jpg
06-exit.jpg.textSnippet: How to build it: drag a block from Blocks across into Your program — or just click it, if you prefer. Drag the blocks up and down to change the order, and drag one back to Blocks to take it out again.
06-exit.jpg.contentAnchor: 🎯 When the flag is clicked, the sprite gets into position without the player seeing it move, then appears in the middle of the screen and animates by changing costume forever.
06-exit.jpg.says: the ordering puzzle, before any block is placed
